Result / explanation: Doctor uses Patient. Team receives an independent Player. Order creates and
owns its private OrderLine.
Relationship Example Ownership · Association Doctor - Patient No whole-part requirement · Aggregation Team - Player Weak · Composition Order - OrderLine Strong
Java references alone do not enforce UML ownership; design and lifecycle rules establish it.
Interview question: What is the difference between aggregation and composition?

Answer: Aggregation allows independently existing parts; composition models strong ownership
and a dependent part lifecycle.
Remember: Association = Uses. Aggregation = Weak HAS-A. Composition = Strong HAS-A.

English: IS-A expresses a subtype relationship; HAS-A expresses an object relationship through
composition or aggregation.
සිංහල: IS-A කියන්Jන් එක type එකකේ තවත් type එකක subtype එකකේ වීම. HAS-A කියන්Jන් object එකක තවත් object එකකේ තිබීම.

Dog IS-A Animal → Car HAS-A Engine
